reviews.comment: Super easy class, attendance was not mandatory. Tests are open note and there are a couple projects that just involve watching movies. Overall he is a very good prof and makes the class interesting.

Genuinely good guy who truly cares about journalism & his students. Lectures could be boring, but he made them very fun. He was always up to date on current news, and he did a very good job of staying bias free when we discussed controversial issues. Projects were just movies to watch, quizzes were easy, final was open note. Would take again.

Im an engineering major and i took this as one of my cores. EASIEST AND BEST CLASS EVER! You can tell he lovess his job and he is the nicest person ever. Grades like ur his grandkid, hundreds on everything. Tests are open note and lecture slides so piece of cake. Didn't study for the final at all, took it and got a 100. He wants you to get an A!

This guy rocks. Lectures are really interesting and always up to date on current issues and topics. There are only two exams but they're open-note AND he counts his own lecture slides as notes. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he randomly posts attendance questions so beware. Take him if you can!!!

Not even in this major but by far my favorite class. He is an amazing professor, and you can tell he loves what he does. He keeps his lectures up to date on new events and is engaging. You'll have to do weekly readings with a pop quiz at the end but they're not bad at all. Exams are all open notes. Pay attention in class and you're golden!
